version.approval_notes:
The attached source archive is this repository at the submitted version's commit.

To rebuild the submitted package on Linux or macOS with Node.js 22 (see .nvmrc) and the zip and unzip tools:

  npm ci
  npm run package:firefox

The add-on is the dist/firefox directory. scripts/build/build-firefox.js lists every Firefox-specific manifest change.

Generated and third-party code:
- src/react/ is not in the source archive: npm run build, which package:firefox runs first, builds it from the react/ folders in src/ with Vite (the *.js bundles and the license files of the npm packages they bundle).
- build/ is not in the source archive either: npm run build bundles the TypeScript in src/ with Rolldown, together with the npm packages it imports (pinyin-pro 3.28.0, unmodified, from package-lock.json), and writes their license texts to build/third-party-licenses.md.

Every other file ships as written.
